schema: CREATE TABLE "Packets" ("packet_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, "latency_ms" INTEGER, CHECK ("latency_ms" > 0));
correct_query: SELECT '[0-10>' AS bucket, COUNT(packet_id) AS cnt FROM Packets WHERE (CAST(latency_ms AS REAL) / 100) >= 0 AND (CAST(latency_ms AS REAL) / 100) < 10 UNION SELECT '10 or more' AS bucket, COUNT(packet_id) AS cnt FROM Packets WHERE (CAST(latency_ms AS REAL) / 100) >= 10

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Replaces unbounded upper bucket with a CTE range LEFT JOIN bounded by a finite sentinel integer (2147483647), excluding valid values at or above the sentinel
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: WITH Buckets AS (SELECT '[0-10>' AS bucket, 0 AS low_bound, 10 * 100 AS high_bound UNION SELECT '10 or more' AS bucket, 10 * 100 AS low_bound, 2147483647 AS high_bound), Assigned AS (SELECT * FROM Buckets AS b LEFT JOIN Packets AS p ON p.latency_ms >= b.low_bound AND p.latency_ms < b.high_bound ORDER BY latency_ms, p.packet_id NULLS LAST) SELECT bucket, COUNT(packet_id) AS cnt FROM Assigned GROUP BY bucket
